title: 13.7. Pītittika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Pītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca napītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Pītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Pītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Pītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca napītisahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Pītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasukhasahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Pītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca napītisahagato ca nasukhasahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Pītisahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca napītisahagato ca nasukhasahagato ca naupekkhāsahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
Sukhasahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe… satta.
Upekkhāsahagataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe… satta.
Pītisahagatañca sukhasahagatañca dhammaṁ paṭicca napītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe… satta. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā aṭṭhavīsa, ārammaṇe catuvīsa …pe… avigate aṭṭhavīsa.
